content.name: Hunter's Prey
entries: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice.

content.name: Hunter's Prey
entries: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

entries.name: Colossus Slayer
entries: Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage to the target if it's missing any of its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

entries.name: Horde Breaker
entries: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.
